list.name: Changes
list.comment: Resolved the Google 2-step verf handling and stock order data creation with capturing correct pack_id.

task.summary: Corrected few API methods to validate response code as well as validating response fields. Improved on Capturing response methods for API. Implemented feature to capture text type response. Also improved on Validate response method. Changed some BaseURI for some API services. Improved on create dynamic objects. Implemented reusable methods to verify objects and elements. Modified click_Object method. Rectified errors for GLHNegativePrompt feature file. Handled exceptions while entering Barcode. Handled exceptions while launching the app. Included method to go back in MOCO ionic app. Handled exceptions while logging the app. Improved method to create walkitem for multiple products. Implemented Patch, delete response methods.

Refined creation of object dynamically. Refined the message validation messages. Implemented the method to handle Exceptions in Create_Object method, if webelement is not found then it should throw the exception and fail. Handled any open alert or dialog boxes, made the script to click on OK or CANCEl after the test execution. Handled the issues while login during 2-step verf, Refined the method of selection of Date in Datepicker, Traverse till the next or back month button is enabled to check for the given date.

Modified the product scan method, click on search button and check if search worked. Modified the selection of item under a particular department, implemented the scroll down feature if item is below the visible screen.

Corrected the issue of capturing wrong pack_id while data creation for stock_order. Corrected the Date time format issue while craeting data for stock_order. Resolved screen scroll down method while selecting specific section items under specific departments. Resolved the white screen issue which comes up after login to the app. Resolved the search of the item issue during item scan. clicking on search button didn't work sometimes. Added the feature to delete all items for MOCO before creating MOCO orders. Implemented the feature of getting previous or future dates at runtime. Implemented the RMS and GCP integration scenarios with MOCO. Handled the capturing access token using User V2, Googe intent exceptions.
Resolved the Google 2-step verf handling and stock order data creation with capturing correct pack_id.
